mechanism.name: itinerary_dependency
mechanism.description: A client dinner occurs before the user's ticketed flight arrives and is linked to a confirmed airport transfer.

incumbent_workload.description: 18:00–21:00 ticketed flight with a 21:15 pickup transfer.

agent_task.description: Book a Friday 19:30 client dinner in Shenzhen that the user can physically attend.

conflict_point: The traveler cannot reach dinner before the current flight lands.
